judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after the planning and red-test phase without actually implementing the production change. `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` and `CHANGELOG.md` are completely untouched in the candidate diff, meaning the new acceptance test in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts` will fail immediately. It did correctly update `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` and wrote a solid acceptance test covering the string, plain object, `undefined`, and `Error` cases. However, it also created a separate `.acceptance.test.ts` file and left `.lore/dod.md` in the tree rather than adding the test to `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts` as the reference did.
